title: Checking two freezer readings

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: Every time I open the cart's freezer to serve someone, the display jumps. I'm trying to find out whether what's inside warms up as much as the air does.
turns.zh: 每次我打開攤車冰櫃招呼客人，顯示的溫度就跳高。我想知道裡面的東西是否也和空氣一樣升溫那麼多。

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: The display measures air by the lid. For the trial, I put a second probe inside a sealed bottle of test liquid on the bottom shelf. What did it show?
turns.zh: 顯示器量的是蓋子附近的空氣。試測時，我把第二支探針放進底層架上一瓶密封的測試液裡。它顯示什麼？

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: The air warmed every time I opened the lid, then cooled quickly. The liquid barely changed. But during our last rush, the air didn't cool all the way back before I opened the lid again.
turns.zh: 我每次掀開蓋子，空氣溫度就升高，之後很快降下來。測試液的溫度幾乎沒變。不過最後一波忙的時候，還沒完全降回原來的溫度，我就又掀蓋了。

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Next run, let's keep the same number of openings but leave more time between them. Then we can see whether the slower pace helps the air get back to where it started.
turns.zh: 下一輪把開蓋次數維持不變，但每次間隔久一點。這樣就知道放慢頻率是否有助於空氣溫度回到原來的讀值。

audioScript:
Every time I open the cart's freezer to serve someone, the display jumps. I'm trying to find out whether what's inside warms up as much as the air does.
The display measures air by the lid. For the trial, I put a second probe inside a sealed bottle of test liquid on the bottom shelf. What did it show?
The air warmed every time I opened the lid, then cooled quickly. The liquid barely changed. But during our last rush, the air didn't cool all the way back before I opened the lid again.
Next run, let's keep the same number of openings but leave more time between them. Then we can see whether the slower pace helps the air get back to where it started.
